notes: New Bundled resources card on the Storage tab: it reads resources/tips.json through app.paths.resources, from both the backend and the page. On macOS, Help → Tiny Deck Help opens a real Apple help book, the Help menu links to the docs and source, and the About panel shows credits from Credits.html. Icon and credits moved into assets/. Built on tinyjs 0.53.0.
